method.rule: A document, section, criterion, ADR or artefact counts as READ only if a finder's coverage note names it (path, basename, section number or id, including bare ids inside ADR-0021/0022-style lists) or one of that finder's finding anchors sits inside it. Everything else is reported UNREAD.
